sub_graphs.title: EIP-1193: Provider Security Isolation
sub_graphs.description: Models the trust boundaries between DApp, Provider, Wallet, and Client

nodes.label: DApp Request Incoming
nodes.description: Request from untrusted DApp environment entering Provider

nodes.label: Sanitize Input Data
nodes.description: Validate and sanitize all data sent from the DApp

nodes.label: Check Rate Limit
nodes.description: Enforce rate limiting on requests from the Provider

nodes.label: Request Rate Limited
nodes.description: Request rejected due to rate limiting

nodes.label: Request Passed Security Checks
nodes.description: Request cleared for forwarding to Wallet

nodes.label: Maintain Provider-Wallet Isolation
nodes.description: Ensure Provider and Wallet programs remain isolated from each other

nodes.label: No Private Data in Provider
nodes.description: Provider does not contain any private user data

external_entities.name: Potentially Malicious DApp
external_entities.description: Untrusted web application that may attempt arbitrary operations on Provider

external_entities.name: Wallet/Client
external_entities.description: Trusted wallet software that must be protected from DApp interference

ambiguities.text: Providers should rate-limit requests - specific rate limits not defined
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume implementations should define reasonable limits (e.g., 10 requests/second) and make them configurable. Exact limits left to implementers.

ambiguities.text: The data property in ProviderRpcError is 'OPTIONAL - contextual information' - structure undefined
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume data can be any JSON-serializable value that provides debugging context. No specific structure required.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define behavior when multiple chains are connected simultaneously
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume eth_chainId returns the 'active' or 'default' chain, and switching is explicit via wallet_switchEthereumChain.

implicit_assumptions.description: The Wallet and Client programs are assumed to be secure and trustworthy
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Compromised Wallet could steal user funds or leak private keys regardless of Provider security

implicit_assumptions.description: The browser provides adequate isolation between DApp JavaScript and Provider internals
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: DApps could directly access Provider internals, bypassing security boundaries

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot modify the Provider object after it is exposed at window.ethereum
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: DApps could intercept or modify Provider behavior to steal user credentials or transactions

implicit_assumptions.description: Event listeners are properly removed when DApps unmount to prevent memory leaks
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Memory leaks and potential for stale event handlers causing incorrect behavior
